name: Mythy Vision
summary:
Mythy Vision is an atlas of the world's stories. Every point on the globe is a tale, placed where it was first told: 2,702 myths, legends, folktales and fairy tales from 169 countries, each with a short retelling, its source and its original name.

Discover how stories travel
Open any story and its closest relatives light up, joined by arcs across the planet. Flood myths from Mesopotamia, India, Greece and the Andes. Creation from the body of a giant, from China to Iceland. Tricksters, swan maidens, journey
